end.description: True on the entry that completes the quest.

id.description: Entry id used by scripts; ascending, e.g. 10, 20, 30.

text.description: Text the player reads in the journal at this stage.

JournalSpec.description: A plain journal quest: a category and its entries (maps to `add_journal_quest` + `add_journal_entry`). For a quest with dialog lines, stage wiring and rewards use the quest spec (`build_quest`) instead.

entries.description: The stages, in order; the last one normally has `end: true`.

name.description: Quest name shown in the journal.

tag.description: Quest tag used by scripts: lower-case letters, digits and underscore.

xp.description: XP for completing the quest. Default 0.
